description: This file 'os_utils.h' defines an interface for OS utility functions, providing wrappers around POSIX threading and directory functions, intended for use across multiple source files in a project.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_CreateThread
methods.description: Creates a new thread with a specified name, start routine, and arguments.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_SetDataModelThread
methods.description: Sets the current thread as the data model thread.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_IsDataModelThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the data model thread, optionally printing a warning.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_CreateDirFromPath
methods.description: Creates a directory from a given path.

methods.name: OS_UTILS_CreateDirFromFilename
methods.description: Creates a directory from a filename.
